title: Bitcoin Surges Above $100,000 as Institutional Adoption Accelerates
content: The world's largest cryptocurrency, Bitcoin, hit a new all-time high today, crossing the $100k mark. Analysts cite increased inflows from spot ETFs and favorable regulatory outlook.

title: Ethereum L2 Scaling Solutions See Record TVL in August
content: Layer 2 networks like Arbitrum and Optimism have reached new highs in Total Value Locked (TVL). This comes as Ethereum mainnet gas fees remain elevated.
